findings.issue: isGrantScopeResolvable for `interval` scope returns `nodes.length > 0` — any non-empty org passes. An interval scope (numeric axis filter, e.g. amount>=5M) does not address an org node, so this is conservative-by-design, but it means an interval-only grant can never be flagged unresolvable regardless of axis correctness.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable per FR-B3-1 (interval is a numeric filter, not an org addressee) and documented inline. No change required; noting as a conservative boundary the caller should be aware of.

findings.issue: G-4 deviation: mode-1 takes gateway routing rules via a GatewayRoute[] DI port rather than extracting gateway/DMN conditions from the BPMN XML. ADR §8.1 says 'детерминированное протаскивание атрибутов через шлюзы/DMN' without mandating XML-conditional extraction.
findings.suggestion: Valid realization choice (G-4 is КАК-not-ЧТО). lintBpmn remains the sole BPMN linter (called first, fail-closed); the route-calc is deterministic. Acceptable. A future increment that wires real BPMN-extracted conditions should reuse this seam.
